description_en: Queries whether a running SQL engine exists
kebab_example: aliyun adb exist-running-sql-engine --db-cluster-id amv-bp1cit7z8j0000 --resource-group-name spark_test --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ExistRunningSQLEngine
